one_month_reasoning: Three scheduled events fall inside the window: TXN Q3 on 2026-10-21 (src 23), NXP Q3 on 2026-10-27 after the close (confirmed by NXP's own release, src 22) and ST's Q3 with Q4 guidance on 2026-10-29 before the open (src 8). Chain reads are positive: Avnet book-to-bill above parity in all regions and a ~+10% q/q guide (src 21), ST's third 2026 price hike and 30-52 week power lead times (src 20). But ST already guided Q3 $3.70B / 37% GM and Q4 >$4B (src 3), and FY26 consensus $14.43B (src 7) less H1 $6.58B and Q3 $3.70B leaves ~$4.15B for Q4, so a revenue beat is largely expected; management says price increases are offset by cost increases (src 5), and the stock fell on 5 of its last 7 results days (mean absolute move 11.5%, src 42), including -18.7% after Q2. 3-month realized vol is 66% (src 42). So: lognormal with ~19% one-month sd (61%/3.5 = 17.4%, widened for two peer prints and its own results), centred a touch below spot, P(>= $49.57) = 0.49.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: A small discount, persistent through the horizon: (1) structurally lower margins: ST GM 34.8% in Q2-26 and 37% guided for Q3 (src 3) vs ~57-64% at TXN, NXP and MCHP (src 10, 11, 13); the >40% model only arrives after reshaping completes at end-2027 (src 5); (2) higher capital intensity: net capex at the top of $2.0-2.2B in 2026 (~15% of revenue, src 4) and D&A 15.7% of revenue (F21/F3); (3) the horizon NTM growth is only ~6-8% (FY28 vs FY27) against 13-80% next-year growth for the peer set today, and the cycle will be ~2 years old. No sell-side outperformance argument is used.

thesis_break_reason: $31 is ~11x my horizon NTM GAAP EPS (~$2.81) and ~11.5x FY27 consensus $2.69 (src 7), 37% below spot and well above the $23 bear value. A close there means the market is pricing the 2027 recovery as failed: Q4-26 >$4B and datacenter 'well above $2B' not delivered, double-ordering unwinding (book-to-bill ~2, src 5; distributor B2B above parity, src 21), or GM stuck in the high-30s after reshaping, rather than ordinary noise in a 61%-vol stock.

catalysts.event: Texas Instruments Q3 2026 results and Q4 guide (analog pricing, industrial/auto read-across)
NXP Q3 2026 results after the close (auto/industrial MCU read-across)
ST Q3 2026 results, Q4 revenue (>$4B) and gross-margin guidance
Infineon FY2026 results and 2027 outlook (AI datacenter power, auto)
ST Q4 2026 results and FY2027 outlook / capex plan
ST Q1 and Q2 2027 results: GM path toward >40%, datacenter 'well above $2B' tracking, AWS warrant vesting
CEO reappointed for only one more year (src 9): succession visibility
Completion of manufacturing reshaping (end-2027 per management, src 5)

key_uncertainties: How long the price-led analog/power upcycle lasts: ST book-to-bill ~2 and 4.5-5 quarters of backlog (src 5), distributor book-to-bill above parity everywhere (src 21) and 30-52 week lead times (src 20) can mean double ordering and a 2028 correction.
Whether ST's GM reaches >40% as reshaping completes at end-2027 (src 5); price increases are offset by cost increases per management (src 5), so pricing alone does not lift margin.
AI datacenter demand durability (>$2B in 2027) given market doubts about AI revenue (src 19); AWS warrants (24.8M at $28.38) dilute as AWS purchases vest them (src 4).
Customer concentration: Apple rose from 12.3% (2023) to 17.7% (2025) of revenue (src 41).
Automotive and China: slower auto growth, China LV production cut for 2027 (src 12, 16), Chinese SiC/MCU price competition (src 14).
The SDNY securities class action is reported (by the supervisor) to be in discovery; I have not verified it and it is not in any number.

long_dated_risks.cash_flow_effect: Revenue -15% from peak and GAAP EBIT margin back to ~8-10% for 1-2 years (2023-25 precedent: revenue -32%, margin 26.7% -> 1.5%, F1/F3, F5/F7)

long_dated_risks.risk: Chinese competition in SiC, power discretes and general-purpose MCUs
long_dated_risks.cash_flow_effect: Caps P&D/MCU margins; FY29/terminal GAAP EBIT margin 18.5% vs 26.7% prior peak

long_dated_risks.risk: Apple content loss or insourcing (17.7% of 2025 revenue)
long_dated_risks.cash_flow_effect: Loss of a few sockets = ~5% of revenue at ~25% incremental margin

long_dated_risks.risk: AI datacenter capex digestion or share loss after 2027
long_dated_risks.cash_flow_effect: Datacenter growth stalls after >$2B in 2027 (~$0.5-1B revenue at risk)

long_dated_risks.risk: Slower EV/auto SiC adoption and China auto-production cuts
long_dated_risks.cash_flow_effect: SiC utilisation and auto mix below plan; unused-capacity charges persist (~70bp in Q3-26, src 3)

reverse_dcf_check: model_engine: at the stated cash flows (FY2029 GAAP EBIT margin 18.5%, 3% terminal growth) the 16.5x NTM P/E implies a WACC of 10.1% vs my 10.5%; equivalently, at 10.5% the multiple needs a long-run GAAP EBIT margin of ~19.5% or ~3.5% growth after 2029. That is plausible (GM 'above 40%' model at $18B, src 5) but leaves no room for the 26.7% 2023-peak margins (F5/F1), consistent with the cycle and China risks above. DCF $43.8 vs P/E $46.4: the gap is small, so the multiple is not stretched.

sbc_treatment.note: GAAP EBIT (after SBC, ~1.4-1.6% of revenue) used throughout; shares held flat (no buybacks in H1 2026; awards delivered from treasury). ST's non-GAAP keeps SBC (Q2 reconciliation excludes only restructuring $58M and MEMS PPA $24M, src 3), while most peers' adjusted EPS excludes SBC (TI reports GAAP only); the 16.5x is therefore set ~6% below the ~17.5x like-for-like peer median. Round 1 wrongly called peer EPS 'SBC-inclusive'.

reasoning: Round 2. Facts: $49.57; FY25 revenue $11.8B, GAAP EBIT $175M (F3, F7); Q2-26 $3.49B, GM 34.8%, GAAP op. income $187M; Q3 guide $3.70B / 37%; Q4 >$4B; datacenter well above $2B in 2027 (src 3); $18B in 2028 and GM >40% only after reshaping ends at end-2027 (src 5). Industry lane: the analog/power chain is in a price-led upcycle (TXN, NXP, MCHP, IFX results, src 10-13; ST's third 2026 price hike and 30-52 week power lead times, src 20; Avnet +47.7% with book-to-bill above parity in every region, src 21), but management says price increases only offset cost increases (src 5), and Avnet's pricing gains were almost all memory. Corrections taken from the supervisor and checked at source: EV/EBITDA leg dropped (circular); peer P/Es rebuilt as price / next-FY consensus (median 16.6x, not 21.5x; I also correct Renesas to 11.9x); adjusted net cash $1,701M; Blume beta 1.32 and ERP 4.5% (WACC 10.5% on the 2026-10-13 10y of 5.21%). Where I differ: tax 18% (ST's own 2026 estimate 18.1% incl. Pillar Two, 2025 19.3%, src 4) not 17%; shares 911M, not 900M, because the Q2 EPS note shows 12.8M dilutive AWS warrant shares (24.2M at $28.38) that the 900M leaves out (src 4); FY28 GAAP EBIT 18% not 19% (GM ~41% less ~$4.2B opex). Valuation: DCF $43.77 (35%), 16.5x P/E $46.36 (65%) = $45.46; scenarios $23.4 / $45.5 / $64.2 at 25/50/25%. Ladder = 60% engine scenario mixture + 40% lognormal (median $48.5, sigma 0.52) to keep fat tails consistent with 61% realized vol (src 42) and to temper a single-model centre; median ~$46, P(>= $50) 0.42, P(>= $74) 0.12, P(< $30) 0.21. Research limited: Octopart's lead-time page returned 403 and is not used; keyed data feeds not used.

discount_rate.basis: Cost of equity = 10y UST 5.21% (Treasury daily par curve 2026-10-13, src 24) + Blume-adjusted beta 1.32 (0.67 x raw 5Y beta 1.48 from src 8 + 0.33) x ERP 4.5% (judgment, as supervisor) = 11.15%; debt weight 8.4% = total financial debt $4.02B (src 3) / ($43.78B market cap src 8 + $4.02B), after-tax cost ~3.5% (zero-coupon converts plus EIB/term loans; judgment); WACC = 0.916 x 11.15% + 0.084 x 3.5% = 10.5%.

horizon_multiples.peer_basis: 10-peer median 16.6x price / next-FY consensus EPS (range 11.9-27.1x, sources 25-40), ~17.5x after adjusting peers' SBC-excluded EPS to ST's after-SBC basis; 16.5x on ST GAAP after-SBC NTM EPS is a ~6% discount for lower gross margin and capital intensity and slower NTM growth at the horizon.

bear.story: Double-ordering unwinds in H1 2027 (book-to-bill ~2, three ST price hikes, distributor B2B above parity), a 2028 correction is priced in by Oct-2027, GM stalls in the high-30s, China SiC/MCU competition and Apple socket risk; ~12.5x depressed NTM EPS.

base.story: Q4-26 >$4B and datacenter well above $2B delivered; revenue ~$17.2B in 2027 (+19%, consensus $17.18B), GAAP EBIT 15% in 2027 and 18% in 2028 as reshaping completes; market pays 16.5x NTM GAAP EPS anticipating a maturing cycle.

bull.story: Price-led upcycle runs through 2028 (lead times 30-52 weeks, further price hikes), datacenter/LEO add >$1B more, GM >40% in 2027; multiple re-rates to ~19.5x, top of the IDM cluster.

model_inputs.structure_note: Standard industrial structure fits. Convertible bonds stay in net financial position (2031/2033 out of the money; 2027 Tranche B settled net-share in Q3 2026, principal in cash). AWS warrants (24.8M at $28.38) counted in the diluted share count by treasury method.
model_inputs.gap_note: fair_value.value equals the engine base horizon value.

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus $17.18B (src 7); Q4-26 >$4B x 4 = $16B+ run-rate plus datacenter 'well above $2B' vs 'above $1B' in 2026 (src 3), book-to-bill ~2 and backlog 4.5-5 quarters (src 5); chain confirms: Avnet book-to-bill above parity in all regions, Q1 FY27 guide +~10% q/q (src 21), ST's third 2026 price hike and 30-52 week power lead times (src 20). Raised from 18.5% in round 1.

Management: 'confidence level to reach $18 billion in 2028' (src 5); 4% in 2029 = long-run analog/power trend; prior peak $17.3B (F1) fell 32% to $11.8B (F3), so cycle risk is carried in the bear case and the multiple.

H1 GAAP op. income $187M + $70M = $257M (src 3) + Q3 ~$330M ($3.70B x 37% = $1,369M GP - ~$1,040M GAAP opex incl. restructuring; Q3 non-GAAP net opex ~$980M, src 5) + Q4 ~$500M ($4.1B x 38.5% - $1,060M) = ~$1.09B / $14.42B = 7.5%.

Bottom-up: GM ~39.5% average (37% Q3-26 guide, 'above 40%' only once reshaping completes end-2027, src 5) x $17.16B = $6.78B - opex ~$4.3B (Q3-26 $980M/qtr growing ~2.5%/qtr) = ~$2.5B = 14.5%. Consensus cross-check: FY27 EPS $2.69 (src 7, after SBC) x 911M = $2.45B / (1-0.18) = $2.99B pretax, less ~$0.06B interest income, plus ~$0.2B restructuring/PPA still excluded (Q2: $58M + $24M, src 3) = ~$2.7B GAAP EBIT = 15.7%. Use 15%. Price hikes do not lift margin: management says price and cost impacts are 'more or less offsetting' (src 5).

FY28: GM ~41% ('above 40%' model at $18B, src 5) x $18.19B = $7.46B - opex ~$4.2B = $3.26B = 17.9%; FY29 GM ~42% at $18.9B less ~$4.35B opex = ~19%, trimmed to 18.5% for China SiC/MCU price pressure. 2023 peak was 26.7% (F5/F1). Supervisor uses 19% / 19.5%.

2026 estimated annual effective rate 18.1% incl. 0.5% Pillar Two; 2025 actual 19.3% before discrete items (src 4). FY23 11.4% and FY24 16.7% (F43/F47, F44/F48) predate the higher profit mix and Pillar Two. Supervisor uses 17%.
FY2025 D&A $1,854M = 15.7% of revenue (F21/F3); absolute D&A grows slowly (~$1.95-2.2B) as revenue rises.

2026: net capex guided 'in the high end of the $2.0 to $2.2 billion range' (src 4); 2,200 / FY26 revenue 14,420 (agent estimate) = 15.2% (guided $ amount, derived %). FY27-29 have no company guidance: agent estimate of ~$2.0-2.1B a year as reshaping completes end-2027 (src 5): 12% x $17.16B = $2.06B, 11% x $18.19B = $2.00B, 11% x $18.92B = $2.08B.
inputs_detail.citation_gate_fix: citation gate 2026-10-14: basis 'guidance' -> 'estimate'; only the 2026 $2.0-2.2B net capex is guided

inputs_detail.derivation: FY2025 SBC $193M / $11,800M = 1.6%; already inside GAAP EBIT, so not deducted again.
Dividends ~$322M declared in H1 2026 (src 4, equity statement) and FY25 $321M (F37); no buybacks in H1 2026 (src 4) vs $367M in FY25 (F33), so a small buyback allowance only.

Adjusted net financial position $1.70B = NFP $2.01B less capital-grant advances for capex not yet incurred (src 3); modelled capex is net of grants, so the grant cash is already spoken for (supervisor finding, accepted). Convertible principal stays in debt.

892.55M outstanding (src 8; includes the ~2.4M treasury shares delivered for the Tranche B net-share settlement, vs 890.15M Q2 basic weighted, src 4) + stock awards 7.7M (Q2 EPS note, src 4) + AWS warrants by treasury method 24.2M x (1 - 28.38/49.57) = 10.4M (src 4) = 910.7M. The 2031/2033 converts are out of the money and stay in debt. Flat: no buybacks in H1 2026 and ~3.8M treasury shares delivered to employees per half (src 4).

Cost of equity 5.21% (10y, 2026-10-13, src 24) + Blume beta 1.32 (0.67 x 1.48 + 0.33; raw beta src 8) x 4.5% ERP = 11.15%; debt $4.02B (src 3) = 8.4% of capital at ~3.5% after tax; 0.916 x 11.15% + 0.084 x 3.5% = 10.5%. Supervisor 10.6% uses the 2026-10-09 print (5.24%).
Semiconductor content growth above nominal GDP; well below the memory-led 2026 market growth (src 17, 18).

10-peer price / next-FY consensus EPS median 16.6x (range 11.99x Renesas to 27.1x TXN); peers' adjusted EPS mostly excludes SBC, so on ST's after-SBC basis ~17.5x (x ~1.06). 16.5x is a ~6% discount for gross margin 35-37% vs 57-64% at TXN/NXPI/MCHP (src 3, 10, 11, 13), net capex ~15% of revenue (src 4) and NTM growth at the horizon of only ~6-8% (FY28 vs FY27) versus 13-80% next-year growth in the peer set today. NTM EPS = engine NOPAT ~$2.56B / 911M.
